mapper.select: SELECT review.id AS review_id, review.result_id, result.attempt_no, review.review_action, review.reviewer_id, reviewer.display_name AS reviewer_name, review.review_reason, review.reviewed_at FROM meter_reading_review AS review INNER JOIN meter_reading_result AS result ON result.id = review.result_id INNER JOIN sys_user AS reviewer ON reviewer.id = review.reviewer_id WHERE review.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY result.attempt_no ASC, review.id ASC
